role: Literature Scout (arxiv_scout.py) + dual-model screening (DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash)
objective: Find sources not yet in SOURCE_REGISTRY on (a) cross-layer KV sharing / per-layer embeddings (mechanism + efficiency) needed to judge novelty of E006/E007, (b) interpretability of non-MHA architectures (MoE, SSM, MLA, sparse/linear attention, TTT).
research_question: Has the information routing through shared K/V (Gemma 3n/4, YOCO, CLA, LCKV) or the prefill saving from it been measured mechanistically/quantitatively before?
allowed_methods: abstract screening by two model families
evidence_requirements: abstract screening is triage only; inclusion in registry as abstract_only; claims need deep_read
budget: 20 arXiv queries, <=2 LLM calls per candidate
acceptance_criteria: every query logged; kappa between screeners reported
limitations: no claim of saturation; arXiv only (no S2/OpenAlex in this pass)
